The visible printed heading ends AU 26/0. The month remainder and any year are not visible, so no complete date is inferred.

The square counts read four squares, eight edges and four vertices, with the first four written over a two.

The detached top stroke of each lower E could be either the top of the letter or an overbar. Each glyph has three horizontal strokes in total. The candidate therefore places unbarred E first and retains barred E as an alternative.
The isolated letter is read G from its open loop and right upright. Its overtraced index has a current 4-like shape, but a prior underlying index cannot be established from this page.
The tracing preserves the visible eight bands in both directions and short or uneven endpoints. The hand-drawn mesh and hatching are approximated without supplying algebraic labels.
